count.description: Compute the exact total match count (count(*) OVER()). Set to false to skip this on callers that don't use the `total` response field and only sweep pages sequentially - it's otherwise recomputed on every page.

cursor.description: Keyset-paginate: only return runs with id greater than this value, ordered by id ascending (overrides sort/order/page). Cheaper than page/limit for sweeping the full result set.

run.description: Only show run associated with a given ID

before.description: Only show runs before the given date

after.description: Only show runs after the given date
